questions.question: With which of the following states is the 'Banganga' Festival associated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Banganga** festival is celebrated at **Malabar Hills, Mumbai**.
 
• It is an **annual music festival celebrated for 2 days **particularly at **Malabar Hills, in Mumbai Maharashtra**.
 
• It is celebrated every year in the **month of January **jointly by **Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation and Indian Heritage society Mumbai**.
 
• Its name is based on a holy water tank named **Banganga Tank in the Walkeshwar Temple complex at Malabar Hills**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The festival was first celebrated in **1992**.
 
• Classical music performances are given by **classical musicians from all over the country to promote and conserve our cultural heritage**.
 
• The ** Walkeshwar Temple was constructed between the 9th and 13th** centuries by the Sahara dynasty.
 
• **The Banganga tank** is constructed along with the temple for** water conservation**.
 
• It was destroyed by the** Portuguese later it was renovated in 1715**.

questions.question: The SI unit of frequency is _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**hertz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **SI** unit of frequency is **hertz,** represented by the symbol **Hz**.
 
• It is named after a **German Physicist Heinrich Hertz **who** discovered** **electromagnetic radiation**.
 
• The **number of waves that pass a fixed point in unit time is called frequency** in other** words cycles per second is called frequency **before hertz it was measured in **cps cycles per second**.
 
• **1 Hz = 1 cps**
 
• Frequency is represented by the symbol **f**.
 
• **f=1/T (T represents time).****​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Volt **is the SI unit of **Potential Difference**.
 
• **Ohm **is the SI unit of **Electrical Resistance**.
 
• **Joule **is the SI unit of **Work and Energy**.

questions.question: In which year did the British Government announce Morley - Minto Reforms in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1909**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Council Act also known as Morley Minto Reforms was introduced in 1909 by Lord Minto then viceroy of India**.
 
• The main aim of these reforms **is to pacify the Indian Political Parties, especially Congress** and the **Muslim League to mark the importance of Indian Leaders in the Governmen**t.
 
• For appeasing communities **separate electorates on the basis of religion were given in this reform.**
 
• **Muslims were given a separate electorate**, they could now have their own representative members at the Legislative Councils.
 
• The **Indians were included in the councils, where ultimate decisions were made, of the India Secretory and Viceroy**.​ ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lord Mayo is also known as the **father of the Communal Electorate In India**.
 
• There was a hidden motive of Britishers to deviate Muslims from the **Nationalist Movement** by granting them separate electorates under the policy of **Divide and Rule.**

 **1932**
 

 British Prime Minister, Ramsay Macdonald announced the "Communal Award" to grant separate electorates to Indian minority communities.

questions.question: When is National Handloom Day celebrated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7th August**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Handloom Day **is celebrated on the **7th of August every year**.
 
• The **National Handloom Day was first celebrated in 2015 on the 7th of August** to commemorate the **Swadeshi Movement which was started on this date in 1905**.
 
• This day is celebrated as Handloom day because **Swadeshi Movement encouraged the indigenous industries and in particular handloom weavers**.
 
• It was first inaugurated by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 7th August 2015 in Chennai**.
 
• It comes under the **Ministry of Textiles of the Government of India** headed by **Smriti Irani**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swadeshi Movement** was** launched with the objective of opposing the Bengal Partition**.
 
• It was officially** launched on the 7th of August 1905 at Calcutta Townhall, Bengal**.
 
• The movement promoted the usage of **made-in-India goods and boycotted British-made goods**.
 
• India's one of the most important **Make In India Campaign is based on this Swadeshi Movement**.

questions.question: What is the full form of an LED?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Light Emitting Diode**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Light Emitting Diode** is a **semiconductor light source** that emits light when current flows from it.
 
• LEDs work on the principle of Electroluminescence
 
• It is **widely used in digital machines and gadgets** like mobile phones, digital billboards, and electrical appliances.
 
• The two primary **materials used in LEDs are aluminium gallium indium phosphide alloys and indium gallium nitride alloys**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **LED **was invented by **Nick Holonyak Jr**. also known as the **Father of Light Emitting Diode in 1962.**

 
• They consume less power and require low operational voltage.

questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India states that Hindi in Devanagari script shall be the official language of the Union?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 343(1)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 343(1) of the Indian constitution **states that the** official language of the** **Union shall be Hindi in the Devanagari script**.
 
• **Part 17 of the Indian Constitution from Article 343 to 351 contains the Official Language of India**.
 
• It is also said that in addition to** the Hindi language English language may also be used for official purposes.**
 
• The purposes for which Hindi alone is to be used, the purposes for which both Hindi and English are to be used, and the purposes for which the English language is to be used, have been specified in the **Official Language Act 1963**.
 
• As per the** 8th Schedule of the Indian constitution**, there are **22 official languages of India.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Article 343(2)**
 For a period of 15 years just after the commencement of the Constitution English will be used as the Official Language of the Union
 
 

 **Article 343(3)**
 
 
After the period of 15 years, the English or Devnagri form on numerals will be used as specified in the law.

questions.question: Which of the following government authorities can appoint the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner of India is appointed by **the President of India.**
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner is the head of the Election Commission** a constitutional body under **Article 324 **responsible for **conducting elections in the country**.
 
• The **Election Commission is 3 member body** in which **2 Election Commissioners and 1 Chief Election Commissioner are appointed**.
 
• The tenure o**f the Chief Election Commissioner is of 6 years or up to the age of 65 years,** whichever is earlier.
 
• They enjoy the same status and receive salary and perks as available to J**udges of the Supreme Court of India.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The powers of the CEC are equal to the other two Election Commissioners every **decision is made on the basis of the majority among them**.
 
• They receive the same salary.
 
• The current CEC of India is **Mr Gyanesh Kumar.**

questions.question: Which of the following states of India became the first state to have a Tsunami Ready Village as of August 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Odisha becomes the first state in India to have Tsunami Ready villages in the first week of August 2020**.
 
• The two coastal villages of Odisha named** Noliasahi in Jagatsingpur district and Venkatraipur in** **Ganjam district **have been declared **“Tsunami Ready” as part of a UNESCO-implemented program**.
 
• These two coastal villages of Odisha have received the **UNESCO-Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC)’s Certificate of Recognition and Certificate of Appreciation**.
 
• The two villages were given the certification based on **11 parameters including preparation of a Community Tsunami Risk Reduction Plan, mapping of tsunami hazard zones, public display of tsunami information, evacuation maps, etc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There was a mock drill conducted by a team of UNESCO in December 2019 to review the preparations.
 
• 
 These Coastal villages of Odisha are highly prone to extreme weather events and the two villages, **in particular, were hit hard during the 1999 Super Cyclone, more than 7000 people lost their lives only from this block of villages.**

questions.question: When was a massive employment-cum-rural public works campaign named 'Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan' (GKRA) launched by the Government of India to empower and provide livelihood opportunities to migrant workers?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**June 2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan (GKRA) was launched on 20th June 2020 from Village – Telihar, Block- Beldaur of Khagaria District of Bihar.**
 
• It is an initiative to tackle the impact of COVID-19 on migrant workers in India.
 
• The main objective of this Abhiyan was **to provide livelihood opportunities to returning migrants and similarly affected rural citizens**.
 
• It was a 125-day Abhiyaan, with a resource envelop of **Rs. 50,000 Crore.**
 
• The main beneficiaries of this Yojna **were the returnee migrant workers and similarly affected rural population of 6 States namely Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It comes under the **Union Finance Ministry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A total of** 116 Districts with more than 25,000 returnee migrant workers** across six States, namely Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, and Odisha have been chosen for the campaign** which includes 27 Aspirational Districts**.
 
• Abhiyaan **involved intensified and focused implementation of 25 target-driven works to provide employment and create infrastructure** in the rural areas of focussed districts.

questions.question: The fiscal policy helps the government of a country to control the flow of:
questions.solution:
The current answer is __**tax revenue**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Through **fiscal policy, **the government of a **country controls** **tax revenue and public expenditure**. 
 
• **Fiscal Policy** plays a remarkable role in the functioning of the economy of any country.
 
• If the government receives more revenue than it spends it becomes in surplus, while if it spends more on tax then it runs a deficit.
 
• In India, it is a guiding force that helps the government to decide **how much it should spend to support the economy and how much it should earn from the economy to make it run smoothly.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **India fiscal policy** is formed by **Finance Ministry**.
 
• **Nirmala Sitaraman **is the current **Finance Minister of India**.
 
• The fiscal policy was first introduced in **India in 2003 under the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act.**

questions.question: Which of the following sanitation campaigns was launched across India on 2 October 2014 by the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation for rural areas?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Swachh Bharat Mission**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM)\ Swachh Bharat Abhiyan**, **or Clean India Mission** is **a country-wide campaign launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 2nd October 2014 to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management**.
 
• Its main objective was to make the country **Open Defecation Free **by **constructing toilets in all the villages of India till 2nd October 2019 which was the 150th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.**
 
• Its first phase is also aimed at **eradicating manual scavenging**.
 
• As a result of the Swachh Bharat Mission, **55 crore people changed their behaviour and started using toilets**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin),** 10.28 crore toilets have been constructed in 36 states/UTs. 603,175 villages were declared open defecation free in five years.**
 
• With the attainment of Swachh Bharat, there has been a **significant reduction in water and sanitation-related diseases.**
 
• After becoming Open Defecation Free (ODF), many villages have seen a **reduction in the number of deaths due to diseases like diarrhoea, malaria, etc**.
 
• The first phase of the mission laster till 2nd October 2019.
 
• Phase 2 is being implemented between** 2020–21 and 2024–25** to help cement the work of Phase 1.

The correct answer is __**Avani Chaturvedi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Avani Chaturvedi** is one of the three first three Indian female fighter pilots who received the **'Nari Shakti Puraskar 2019' on 8th March 2020**.
 
• The President of India presented the prize to **Avani Chaturvedi along with Mohana Jitarwa and Bhawna Kanth**.
 
• **The trio was inducted into the IAF's fighter squadron after the Government of India decided to open a fighter stream in the force for women on an experimental basis**.
 
• The three were first to be inducted into the squadron and conduct a solo flight in** MIG-21 in 2018**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shivangi Singh** is the first **Rafael female pilot to take part in the Republic Day Parade in 2022.**
 
• **Bhawna Kanth** is the first female pilot who took part in the **Republic Day parade in January 2021**.

questions.question: What is the main religion of Myanmar?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Theravada Buddhism **is the main religion of **Myanmar**.
 
• Nearly 88% population of Myanmar follows Buddhi

questions.question: In which year was the office of the first Accountant General established in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1858**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The office of the first **Accountant-General was established in India in 1858**.
 
• This year **the British took over administrative control of India from the East India Company.**
 
• In 1860 Sir Edward Drummond was appointed as the first Auditor-G
